Custom.description: Basic operator for WCMSA. After CodeLevelKalmanPredictor and CodeLevelRayTracing provide predicted position and CQI, Custom must determine slice type, bandwidth, throughput, and QoS.
Custom.interface: custom(input: str, instruction: str) -> dict with key 'response' of type str

ScEnsemble.description: Self-consistency voting for mobile service decisions. Generates multiple allocation proposals and picks the most consistent one. Use for higher accuracy at 3-5x cost.
ScEnsemble.interface: sc_ensemble(solutions: List[str], problem: str) -> dict with key 'response' of type str

CodeLevelKalmanPredictor.description: Code-level helper (NOT an LLM operator). Extracts trajectory from problem text and predicts next position using constant-velocity Kalman Filter. Returns pred_x, pred_y, region. Use inject_prediction() to append position to problem text.
CodeLevelKalmanPredictor.interface: kalman.predict(problem: str) -> dict; kalman.inject_prediction(problem: str, pos_info: dict) -> str

CodeLevelRayTracing.description: Code-level helper (NOT an LLM operator). Calls ray_tracing tool directly at Python level to get accurate CQI at a given position. Use get_cqi_at() with predicted position from KalmanPredictor.
CodeLevelRayTracing.interface: rt.get_cqi_at(x: float, y: float, region: str) -> dict; rt.inject_cqi(problem: str, cqi_info: dict) -> str

MobileServiceAssuranceAgent.description: ReAct-based agent with 6 domain-specific tools including Kalman Filter predictor and ray_tracing. The agent calls tools via XML. Works but relies on executor LLM's XML parsing ability.
MobileServiceAssuranceAgent.interface: msa_agent(problem: str, trajectory_history: List, max_steps: int = 6) -> dict with 'answer'

DirectMobileSolver.description: Direct LLM-based mobile service solver. Sends problem directly to LLM with structured prompt to get all 6 fields. Simpler than MobileServiceAssuranceAgent (no ReAct loop). Less accurate without code-level position/CQI.
DirectMobileSolver.interface: direct_solver(problem: str) -> dict with 'answer' of type str

tools.kalman_filter_predictor: Predict next user position using Kalman Filter
tools.ray_tracing: Get CQI at a position using real building data
tools.slice_allocator: Allocate user to eMBB (6-20MHz) or URLLC (1-5MHz) slice
